Look intently at the usb end of the device and locate the slotted portion of the plug where there are holes. Consider this the operational "up" side of the usb device.

Look at your device of interest where you want to connect usb of interest. This is easier if it is a horizontal port, but determine what operational up is for said device. finally, and this is the most important part, if complications arise remember that the usb still has a mind of its own and will decided to not work anyway on the first try. The motivation for this idea is comes from subverses like v4v. In that subverse, you can meet up with people in real life. However, some people who would otherwise benefit from subverses like this might decide not to participate because they don't feel safe meeting up with random people on the internet. This could be overcome by having a feedback subverse for each user. Then if two users have a good interaction, they leave each other positive feedback, or if some one does something wrong, they will get negative feedback.

I used an example of real-life interaction, but really any meaningful interaction carries some risk. Therefore, I hope the feedback subverse would increase voaters ability to be able to have meaningful interactions with each other.

The feedback subverse could also be used for internet interactions as well. For example, you could leave some one positive feedback if they give a helpful answer to a question you ask.

I can think of two drawbacks to this idea. One is that feedback will be given malicously (for example, "give me what I want or I will leave bad feedback"). The other drawback is that it is not clear how to moderate the subverse. The subject of the subverse should not be allowed to moderate it, because that would kind of defeat the point.
